package.name: aimdk_dataplane
package.description: The AgiBot X2 runtime's data plane as a native process: takes every joint, hand and arm command sample of the HAL, publishes the public joint state views, hand touch and arm command echo, and owns the fixed-rate command stream to the motion-control unit. aimdk_robot keeps the control plane. The node is built only when the AimDK vendor overlay provides aimdk_msgs.
